Deterministic Synthetic LLM Rater Backend

Source: R/backends.R
backend_mock.Rd

Creates an offline, deterministic mock LLM backend parameterized by an explicit psychometric measurement model. Supports configurable true-score slope/calibration, additive and interaction variance components (prompt, model, unit-by-prompt, unit-by-model, prompt-by-model), temperature noise, uniform and non-uniform Differential Prompt Functioning (DPF), prompt-by-group DPF interactions, temporal/version drift, and optional malformed-JSON injection for testing retry pipelines.

Usage

backend_mock(
  seed = 1234L,
  intercept = 0,
  true_score_slope = 1,
  true_score_col = "true_score",
  error_sd = 0.5,
  temp_noise_sd = 0.5,
  prompt_sd = 0.25,
  model_sd = 0.2,
  unit_prompt_sd = 0.25,
  unit_model_sd = 0.2,
  prompt_model_sd = 0.15,
  prompt_bias = NULL,
  model_bias = NULL,
  dpf_uniform = NULL,
  dpf_nonuniform = NULL,
  dpf_prompt_group = NULL,
  group_col = "group",
  drift_per_wave = 0,
  version_shift = NULL,
  wave_col = "wave",
  malformed_rate = 0,
  score_field = NULL
)

Arguments

seed

Integer random seed for deterministic synthetic generation.

intercept

Overall additive bias (calibration intercept shift).

true_score_slope

Calibration slope multiplying the unit true score.

true_score_col

Name of the numeric true-score column in the input data frame (if present in request$meta). If absent, a deterministic latent true score \(T_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 1)\) is generated per unit_id.

error_sd

Standard deviation of independent measurement error.

temp_noise_sd

Additional error standard deviation multiplied by temperature.

prompt_sd

SD of random prompt main effects (when prompt_bias does not specify a prompt).

model_sd

SD of random model main effects (when model_bias does not specify a model).

unit_prompt_sd

SD of unit x prompt interaction variance component.

unit_model_sd

SD of unit x model interaction variance component.

prompt_model_sd

SD of prompt x model interaction variance component.

prompt_bias

Optional named numeric vector of fixed prompt main effects.

model_bias

Optional named numeric vector of fixed model main effects.

dpf_uniform

Optional named numeric vector of uniform subgroup shifts keyed by subgroup level (e.g. c(group_b = 0.75)).

dpf_nonuniform

Optional named numeric vector of subgroup slope shifts multiplying the true score (e.g. c(group_b = -0.35)).

dpf_prompt_group

Optional numeric matrix (rows = prompt IDs, cols = subgroup levels) specifying prompt-by-group DPF interactions.

group_col

Column name in input data identifying subgroup membership.

drift_per_wave

Numeric mean drift per unit increase in wave_col.

version_shift

Optional named numeric vector of fixed shifts keyed by wave_col (or version label).

wave_col

Column name in input data identifying temporal wave or model version.

malformed_rate

Probability in [0, 1] of returning malformed JSON on attempt 1 (useful for testing schema validation and retry behavior).

score_field

Name of the primary numeric/factor field in the schema. Defaults to the first field in the schema.

Value

An object of class c("llm_backend_mock", "llm_backend").

Details

Calls are hashed deterministically from (seed, unit_id, prompt_id, model, temperature, replicate) without mutating R's global .Random.seed.

Examples

b <- backend_mock(seed = 42, error_sd = 0.4, prompt_sd = 0.3, model_sd = 0.2)
b
#> 
#> ── LLM Backend (mock) 
#> ID: mock_ada1a0b8a39e
#> Seed: 42 | Slope: 1 | Intercept: 0 | Error SD: 0.4
#> Facet SDs: prompt=0.3, model=0.2, u:p=0.25, u:m=0.2, p:m=0.15
